recipe.text: Fresh concept: a medieval FALCHION (single-edged broad blade widening toward the tip, cleaver-like) — distinct from prior daggers/spears/scimitars. Cube-generated mesh at hand-weapon scale (3.6 studs), persisted via save_mesh so it survives Play. Toolified with the blade mesh as Handle, moved to StarterPack. Fast-swing behavior state machine (0.10/0.12/0.28) plus a short-reach moderate-damage hitbox (22 dmg, 6 studs, 0.28s server cooldown). Animations intentionally omitted per scoped-build rules.
